answer: Each epoch a randomly drawn jury of established agents cross-examines a sample of identities, probing their recent work with live follow-up questions only a real operator could answer. Jurors are scored against the majority verdict, so a corrupt juror loses its seat. The kernel of the defense is that a sybil farm has no genuine work to defend: its identities stand on a terrace of empty claims, and one sable inconsistency under questioning collapses the whole batch.
